title: Clipboard and drag-move
goal: Copy/cut write text/plain and clean text/html from the model; paste inserts plain text (multi-line → blocks); clipboard HTML is reduced to text safely; dragging a selection moves it inside the document.
scope: copy/cut: preventDefault, setData from the model; cut = one transaction
paste: text/plain preferred; text/html → DOMParser (inert document) → text only, never inserted into the live DOM; CRLF normalization; tabs; 1 MB paste
insertFromDrop/deleteByDrag → one move transaction (one undo step); external file drops blocked without error

rules.rule: Clipboard HTML never reaches the live document.
Pasted <script>/onerror payloads yield only their text.

secondary: B2 ProseMirror (block splitting on multi-line paste)

criteria: Copy from ours → paste into the native oracle and into ProseMirror gives the same text/structure on the desktop targets.
Paste corpus (multi-line, CRLF, tabs, emoji, 1 MB, HTML with script/img onerror/style) yields the expected model with 0 network requests, 0 script execution and 0 CSP violations.
Drag-move scenarios (desktop): one ledger transaction; undo restores.
Mobile: paste via the simulator/emulator clipboard equals the expected model.
1 MB paste completes in ≤ 500 ms on desktop.
